import os,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
exec(compile(Path(os.environ['TEMP'],'chatwoot-branch-execute.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').split("if __name__=='__main__':")[0],'<reviewed-helpers>','exec'))
def cleanup():
 for role,r in R.items():
  guard(r);verify_rules(r,probe=True)
  state=S['resources'][str(r['id'])]
  assert {v['id'] for v in api('repos/'+r['slug']+'/rulesets')}=={state['ruleset_id']},'Unknown rule drift'
  for name,sha in state['refs'].items():assert name in [r['probe'],r['head']] and read_ref(r,name)==sha,'Owned ref drift'
  if 'pr_number' in state:
   d=api('repos/'+r['slug']+'/pulls/'+str(state['pr_number']))
   assert d['head']['ref']==r['head'] and d['head']['sha']==state['head_sha'] and d['base']['ref']==r['probe'] and not d['merged']
   if d['state']=='open':
    record('before_close_probe_pr',id=r['id'],number=d['number'],status='PRECONDITION_PASS')
    d=api('repos/'+r['slug']+'/pulls/'+str(state['pr_number']),'PATCH',{'state':'closed'})
   assert d['state']=='closed' and not d['merged'];record('close_probe_pr',id=r['id'],number=d['number'],merged=False,status='PASS')
  payload=config(r);record('before_remove_probe_target',id=r['id'],ruleset_id=state['ruleset_id'],status='PRECONDITION_PASS')
  d=api('repos/'+r['slug']+'/rulesets/'+str(state['ruleset_id']),'PUT',payload)
  assert d['id']==state['ruleset_id'];record('remove_probe_target',id=r['id'],ruleset_id=d['id'],status='PASS');verify_rules(r,probe=False)
  assert api('repos/'+r['slug']+'/rules/branches/'+r['probe'])==[],'Test ref still protected; do not delete'
  for name,sha in state['refs'].items():
   assert read_ref(r,name)==sha;record('before_delete_owned_ref',id=r['id'],ref=name,sha=sha,status='PRECONDITION_PASS')
   api(owned_ref(r,name),'DELETE')
   try:read_ref(r,name)
   except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:assert error.code==404
   else:raise AssertionError('Owned ref still exists')
   record('delete_owned_ref',id=r['id'],ref=name,sha=sha,status='PASS')
  heads=guard(r);assert heads==baseline(r)['branches'],'Unexpected extra/missing branch after cleanup'
  state['cleanup']='PASS';record('cleanup_final',id=r['id'],heads=heads,actions_enabled=api('repos/'+r['slug']+'/actions/permissions')['enabled'],status='PASS')
 print('Cleanup PASS; original branch heads retained, only main targets remain',flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
 try:cleanup()
 except Exception as error:record('cleanup_failure',status='FAIL',error_type=type(error).__name__);raise
